title: Track the workspaces you keep current
summary: ia workspaces list, add, find and remove keep your own list of the workspaces you keep current, in tracked-workspaces.json in the IA home: find walks a folder to a bounded depth and tracks what it found only with --apply, a tracked root that is gone shows as missing until removed, and ia init --apply offers to track the workspace it creates. The list is separate from the MCP server's workspace-locations.json, which tracking never reads or writes.
